title: PBA: Jordan Heading, TNT agree on 3-year contract extension

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Jordan Heading is set to sign a three-year contract extension with TNT after the two sides were able to agree in principle on a new deal. Heading expressed elation over the agreement, which the team announced before walloping the lowly Macau Giant Pandas in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup, 142-87, on Tuesday. “I’m super-excited and super thankful to TNT for putting so much trust and faith in me,” Heading said after the game at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. The southpaw guard said negotiations were “normal” and that “we wanted to make it as sweet as possible.” His contract, a two-year pact […]...
